senses.gloss: (√בס, v. בסם) to begin to boil, to be in the first stage of ripening; v. next w.—Denom. בּוֹסֶר, בְּסוֹרָה.—Trnsf. (v. בָּשַׂר) to be glad.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> end (play on <he>לב בשר</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 36:26">Ezek. XXXVI, 26</cite>), [read as] <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 61:6">Yalk. Gen. 61</cite> <he>לב בוסר בחלקו של חבירו</he> a heart rejoicing in the good fortune of his neighbor.—V. <cite ref="B01368"><he>בָּשַׂר</he></cite>.
